title: От Луки 8 — Luke 8
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: И когда собралась большая ___, Он рассказал им притчу.
cases.translation: And when a great crowd gathered, he told them a parable.
cases.explain: Толпа is the grammatical subject of собралась (gathered) → nominative.

cases.sentence: Несколько женщин были исцелены от злых ___ и болезней.
cases.translation: Several women had been healed of evil spirits and sicknesses.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) always governs the genitive → духов (genitive plural).

cases.sentence: Однажды Иисус сказал своим ___, «Переправимся на другую сторону озера».
cases.translation: Once Jesus said to his disciples, "Let's go over to the other side of the lake."
cases.explain: Сказал (said) takes its addressee in the dative — ученикам, the ones spoken to.

cases.sentence: Иисус объясняет ___ о сеятеле и семенах.
cases.translation: Jesus explains the parable of the sower and the seeds.
cases.explain: Притчу is the direct object of объясняет (explains) → accusative.

cases.translation: They got into a boat and set off.
cases.explain: В + accusative marks motion into a place with a verb of motion (сели в лодку) → лодку.

cases.sentence: Женщина подошла дрожа и пала перед ___.
cases.translation: The woman came trembling and fell down before Jesus.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before / in front of) always takes the instrumental → Иисусом.

cases.sentence: Иисус ходил из города в город, провозглашая радостную весть о Божьем ___.
cases.translation: Jesus went about from town to town, proclaiming the good news of God's Kingdom.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about) takes the prepositional case → царстве.

cases.sentence: Он жил не в ___, а в гробницах.
cases.translation: He did not live in a house, but among the tombs.
cases.explain: В marking a fixed location (not motion) after жил takes the prepositional → доме.

reading.ru: После этого Иисус ходил из города в город и из селения в селение, провозглашая радостную весть о Божьем Царстве.
reading.question: What was Jesus doing as he traveled from town to town?
options: Proclaiming the good news of God's Kingdom
reading.correct: Proclaiming the good news of God's Kingdom
reading.explain: The chapter opens with Jesus going through cities and villages, preaching the good news of God's Kingdom.

reading.ru: Мария, прозванная Магдалиной, из которой вышли семь демонов, и Анна, жена Хузы, управляющего домом Ирода, Сусанна и многие другие.
reading.question: How many demons had gone out of Mary Magdalene?
reading.explain: The text says Mary Magdalene was the one "from whom seven demons had gone out."

reading.question: What does the parable's opening line describe?
options: A farmer going out to sow seed
A shepherd searching for a lost sheep
reading.correct: A farmer going out to sow seed
reading.explain: The parable begins, "The farmer went out to sow his seed."

reading.ru: Они взошли и принесли урожай во сто раз больше того, что было посеяно.
reading.question: How much of a harvest did the seed on good soil produce?
options: A hundred times what was sown
reading.correct: A hundred times what was sown
reading.explain: The seed on good ground "grew, and produced one hundred times as much fruit."

reading.ru: «У кого есть уши, чтобы слышать, пусть слышит».
reading.question: What does Jesus say at the end of the parable of the sower?
options: "He who has ears to hear, let him hear"
"Let the little children come to me"
reading.correct: "He who has ears to hear, let him hear"
reading.explain: After telling the parable, Jesus called out, "He who has ears to hear, let him hear!"

reading.question: What does the seed represent in the parable?
reading.explain: Jesus explains, "The seed is the word of God."

reading.ru: Никто, зажегший светильник, не ставит его под сосуд или под кровать, наоборот, его ставят на подставку, чтобы входящие видели свет.
reading.question: What does a person do with a lamp after lighting it, according to Jesus?
options: Put it on a stand so people can see the light
reading.correct: Put it on a stand so people can see the light
reading.explain: Jesus says no one lights a lamp and hides it, but puts it on a stand so those entering may see the light.

reading.ru: «Мои мать и братья — это те, кто слушает Слово Божие и исполняет его».
reading.question: Whom does Jesus call his true mother and brothers?
options: Those who hear the word of God and do it
reading.correct: Those who hear the word of God and do it
reading.explain: Jesus answers that his mother and brothers are those who hear the word of God and do it.

reading.ru: Проснувшись, он запретил ветру и бушующим волнам, они утихли, и наступил штильб.
reading.question: What did Jesus do when he woke up during the storm?
options: He rebuked the wind and the waves, and they calmed down
He told the disciples to row harder
He asked the disciples to pray
reading.correct: He rebuked the wind and the waves, and they calmed down
reading.explain: Jesus woke and rebuked the wind and the raging waves, and they ceased, and it became calm.

reading.ru: «Легион», — ответил тот, потому что в него вошло много демонов.
reading.question: What name did the demon-possessed man give when Jesus asked his name?
reading.explain: He answered "Legion," because many demons had entered him.

reading.ru: Когда демоны вышли из этого человека и вошли в свиней, все стадо бросилось с обрыва в озеро и утонуло.
reading.question: What happened to the herd of pigs after the demons entered them?
options: They rushed down the bank into the lake and drowned
They ran away into the hills
They were sold to the villagers
reading.correct: They rushed down the bank into the lake and drowned
reading.explain: The whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and drowned.

reading.ru: Его единственная дочь, которой было около двенадцати лет, умирала.
reading.question: What was happening to Jairus's only daughter?
options: She was dying, at about twelve years old
She was lost in the crowd
She had run away from home
reading.correct: She was dying, at about twelve years old
reading.explain: Jairus's only daughter, about twelve years old, was dying.

reading.question: What happened immediately after the woman touched the edge of Jesus' cloak?
reading.explain: As soon as she touched the fringe of his cloak, her flow of blood stopped.

reading.ru: «Дочь моя, твоя вера исцелила тебя. Иди с миром».
reading.question: What did Jesus tell the woman after she was healed?
options: "Your faith has healed you, go in peace"
reading.correct: "Your faith has healed you, go in peace"
reading.explain: Jesus said to her, "Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace."

reading.ru: Иисус же взял ее за руку и сказал, «Дитя, встань».
reading.question: What did Jesus do to raise Jairus's daughter?
options: He took her by the hand and told her to get up
He prayed over her for an hour
He sent everyone away and wept
reading.correct: He took her by the hand and told her to get up
reading.explain: Jesus took her by the hand and called out, "Child, arise!"
